# GitHub Integration

This layer manages interactions with the GitHub API, including handling requests, scheduling tasks, and managing session tokens.

## Overview

The GitHub Integration layer is responsible for all interactions with the GitHub API. It handles requests, schedules tasks, and manages session tokens.

## Responsibilities

- Handle requests to the GitHub API.
- Schedule tasks using a cron job.
- Manage session tokens for secure API access.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `ACTION_REPOSITORY`, `APP_ID`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `CONTENTS_PATH_STYLE`, `GITHUB_API_URL`, `GITHUB_WEB_URL`, `PRIVATE_KEY`, `PUBLIC_URL`, `SETTINGS`, `SETUP_QUEUE`, `WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
- Configuration files: `.github/workflows/docturnal.yml`, `app/tsconfig.json`, `app/wrangler.toml`.
